content: Nkɔɔrà a mbuur aŋàkwɛkà
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Petɔlà anà Ywan bàkäl mubeenà ntɔn mukàyamà u ndwà a Nzam u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi.

Kyekà ilä byanswà ba bàfatwaalà ŋatoo mwɛy sɛmà mböör ande, waa bàfun'tɔɔlà u munàmbwo a ndwà a Nzam tsütsü a ibeenà bàfàbel naa « La Bɛɛl Pɔrte » ntɔn nde ulɔ̈ɔ̈mà ngim akà baar bàfabilà u ndwà a Nzam.
Umpal kàmɛn nde Petɔlà anà Ywan bàmubilà u ndwà a Nzam, nde kalɔ̈ɔ̈m ngim.
Petɔlà anà Ywan waa bun'syebà. Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Iler. »
Mbuur awà kaler ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Nde kàsii naa nde awal undiir mwɛy akà ba.
Petɔlà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ ngim yatɛy, itàkal wɔl, wɛɛ undiir in'wà mɛ awà mɛ in'kyer apà wa: Kà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ un'nsi Nasàlɛr, mbarà, kyen. »
Apan nde kun'te mpi u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, waa kumbaar. Papan sye in'kɔl anà nkɔn a in'kɔl ande waa myàtsim,
nde waa kàfumà, kàmbarà, kàsɛmà mukyà dwaan. Nde kàbilà anà ba u ndwà a Nzam, wàmukyà, mufumà anà musyäŋà Nzam.
Baar banswà bun'mɛn mukyà dwaan anà musyäŋà Nzam.
Ba bàkyer ayöbà naa wà mbuur afàkal aŋàbwaay tsütsü a « La Bɛɛl Pɔrte » mulɔɔmà ngim. Muman ndaa yun'yeel, baar bàkäl mutɛɛr anà muman bɔɔmà aŋàkir.
An'lɔɔŋ a Petɔlà u ndwà a Nzam
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàsàwɛy anki Petɔlà anà Ywan. Un'sɛŋ wanswà kàyi wa, kàköŋ tsütsü apà ba u làpaŋ a ndwà a Nzam, ungyɛl a ta a ndwà a Salɔmun wàmutɛɛr a bɔɔmà.

Mpal kàmɛn Petɔlà abun, nde kàtɛn a un'sɛŋ naa: « Abaal a Isàlɛl, ntɔn nkye làkabemà bɛ ntɔn ndaa yan'lyaaŋ yi? Ntɔn nkye lileerà bɛ apɔŋaa asànaa u ngwal abi itàkal unsà inzaam abi waa bi kambaar mbuur wà?
Aay, wà Nzam a Abàlam, wà Izak anà Zakɔb, Nzam a bànkaa abi, kan'sà un'syääl ande Yɛsu làkoo, Yɛsu akwà bɛ, làyälà bɛ anà làtön bɛ u mii a Pilatu umpal kàkwen nde mukun'tsuuŋ.
Ɛɛ, bɛ, bɛ làkyer atɔn Ŋun'kyɛɛl anà wàbalàbal, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làsɔ̈ɔ̈l un'dwää baar mukun'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Abun bɛ làdwä aŋamɔ̈ɔ̈. Wɛɛ Nzam kun'twey kà ukwà, bi ibà ambäl a ndaa ayi.
Ntɔn làkwikilà amu ikɔb a Yɛsu, ngwal a ikɔb aki yan'fuur ngwal ambarà akà mbuur làmanà bɛ anà làyöb bɛ wà. Làkwikilà amu Yɛsu lan'kɔɔr ubwaŋàbwaŋ mbuur wà kusà a bɛ banswà.
Wɛɛ apanà, atɔŋ, mɛ inkyàyöb naa ntɔn ukɔɔn ayöb waa bɛ anà amfum abɛ sye làkyer abà akà Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ Nzam kan'kwey ndaa kàtɛn nde itaan u mun a aŋangɔɔm ande naa Klistɔ ande akyer asàman mpay.
Abun, làbuul mpem abɛ, làsɔɔm nkääl abɛ, ntɔn mubiiŋ man'be abɛ.
Apan, Mwol asàtwaal paŋà a duu, waa usàtɔm mbuur kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde kusà ntɔn bɛ: Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ apanà, Yɛsu atàkal u du tii mpal isàsɔɔmà ndaa yanswà asànaa kàkyään Nzam u mun a aŋangɔɔm inkyɛɛl ande itaan.
Lalan, unsà ndaa ayi Mɔsɛ kàtɛn naa: "Mwol, Nzam abɛ asàlatweey ŋangɔɔm asànaa mɛ, nde asàkal umwɛy uboo a un'sɛŋ abɛ. Bɛ làkyer asàkyey ndaa yanswà usàlakyään nde.
Mbuur wanswà asàkɔɔn awem ndaa a ŋangɔɔm awà bàkyer asun'böŋ kà un'sɛŋ a Nzam."
Wɛɛ aŋangɔɔm bàtɛn sɛmà Sàmwel, ba banswà umwɛy umwɛy, bàkyer akyäänà ilä abi.

Ilää kàsi Nzam u mbwo a aŋangɔɔm kyà ntɔn bɛ, bɛ sye làbye anà kab uboo a nkwà kàdi Nzam anà andweer abɛ mpal kàtɛn nde a Abàlam naa: "Mɛ in'sàsaak an'bɔr manswà u mɛɛn u mbwo a ikyee angye."
Abun, Nzam kàtwey un'syääl ande utàtwɛb ntɔn bɛ, nde kun'töm ntɔn nde kàlasaak anà kàlalwom unsà an'kyän abɛ man'be. »
